cohort: 87 infants born at 23 weeks of gestation
finding: Multiple perinatal factors, including outborn status, multiple birth, lack of antenatal steroids, and lower birth weight, were significantly associated with mortality and neurological impairment at 2 years of age in infants born at 23 weeks of gestation.
mod_finding: While mode of delivery was recorded in this study, the abstract does not report any findings related to mode of delivery.
birth_weight: Mentioned as a factor but no specific range provided
